responsibility: This module contains GCC’s OpenVMS target support, covering both target configuration and the VMS-specific host/toolchain adaptation needed to compile, link, and run code in VMS conventions rather than generic Unix ones. Its core headers and target sources define the VMS ABI, data-model and predefined-macro policy, target options such as pointer-size and malloc64 modes, and code-generation hooks that rewrite builtin and runtime references to the appropriate VMS CRTL or DPML entry points and emit VMS-specific function-start or main-program symbols. Around that core, the C-family and Fortran glue files provide frontend behavior unique to VMS, including pragmas, include-path/module handling, and option overrides, while the wrapper utilities for ar and ld translate GNU-style archive and linker invocations into native VMS LIBRARY and LINK commands. Supporting files such as stdint mappings, shared prototypes, generated runtime-name maps, and host-configuration definitions make this the module that bridges GCC’s frontends, backend hooks, and driver/tool interfaces to the OpenVMS environment.
